title: MSc (thesis) and PhD in Computing Science (2027/28)
institution: University of Alberta, Department of Computing Science
about: The University of Alberta's Department of Computing Science accepts applications for its thesis-based MSc and PhD programs for 2027/28 until December 15, 2026. Supporting documents are due January 15, 2027; decisions are made on a rolling basis.
requirements: Transcripts, degree certificates and English language test results due by January 15, 2027
All required documents and reference letters must be submitted by the posted deadline
The department admits once a year (Fall); no Winter, Spring or Summer admission
